summary: Full E2E testing (backend + frontend) of FabSupply inventory & customer intelligence app. All 12 backend pytest tests pass; all 9 critical frontend flows verified in Playwright including login, dashboard KPIs & charts, inventory CRUD & adjust, customer list & detail, AI insights (Claude Sonnet), and invoice creation with stock deduction.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_data() generates ~9 months of randomized invoices on empty DB — good; uses `random` so counts vary between fresh installs. Consider seeding deterministic invoices for reproducible tests.

AI insights endpoint has no timeout wrapper; if Claude API stalls the FE spinner spins indefinitely (no client-side timeout in axios instance). Consider adding a request timeout (~30s) and better error toast.
CORS `allow_origins` in server.py hardcodes localhost:3000 in addition to FRONTEND_URL env — consider driving entirely from env for prod safety.

Console hydration warning: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` appears in Invoices dropdowns — caused by the tooling instrumentation wrapping text nodes; benign in this environment but would be a React hydration warning in strict mode. Not a code fault.

Backend `create_product` route allows unrestricted create/delete — any authenticated user (role staff or admin) can mutate catalog. Role-based restriction is not enforced anywhere despite `role` field being present.
test_credentials: owner@fabsupply.ca / FabSupply2026! (works; access_token httpOnly cookie is set correctly)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 10 products, 3 customers (Dawson/Chen/Tremblay) and ~15-20 randomized invoices on empty DB via startup event. Tests created 1 TEST_ product (cleaned up) and 1 additional invoice (INV-1020) that persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Backend uses httpOnly cookies via /api/auth/login; frontend axios has withCredentials:true. Metric labels on CustomerDetail use CSS text-transform:uppercase so page.inner_text may show them lowercase — use data-testids (metric-total-spent, metric-orders, metric-frequency, metric-monthly) instead of text matching. Invoice product dropdown has a React hydration warning from instrumentation tooling — cosmetic only.
